correctness.rationale: The exact dihedral two-generator criteria give the isolated-plus-complete-multipartite decomposition. False twins imply at most one white vertex per part, and three whites in distinct parts cannot start a force. Two whites in distinct parts force exactly when at least one of their parts has a blue sibling, yielding the piecewise leading coefficient. The rank-two witness at k=1 and Lorentz rank-three witness at k>=2 have the exact off-diagonal pattern. For k>=2, each part has at least three vertices; any hypothetical rank-two factorization would require one isotropic line per part, impossible because a nondegenerate symmetric form on R^2 has at most two such lines.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete forcing census and exact real inverse-eigenvalue parameter on a standard family of generating graphs. The transition from prime to higher prime-power rotation order changes the minimum rank from two to three and produces the clean strict gap Z=M+1, a natural structural boundary rather than an arbitrary finite case.
